scope: Principal displayed concepts, worked examples and quick checks across 149 Chemistry lesson JSON files, with targeted narration follow-through; not rendered/audio certification.

findings.problem: A fixed boiling point is incorrectly treated as definitive proof of purity.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: NaCl recovery over-relies on cooling crystallisation; distillation instructions imply boiling the flask dry.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Chromatographic Rf matching is treated as unique identification; ethanol distillation needs the azeotrope qualification.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: The proposed chromatography/distillation sequence does not explain recovery of iodine and sugar.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Charge-product comparison is stated as an exact fourfold actual attraction and a universal ranking rule.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Elemental tungsten is modelled as a small highly charged cation donating about six electrons.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: CO₂ sublimation is called boiling and diamond is assigned an ordinary atmospheric melting point.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: A universal IMF-strength ladder ignores size, polarizability and molecular shape.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Solubility is determined from enthalpy alone, omitting entropy and exceptions.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Isotope chemistry is called identical and an approximate mass-number average is not distinguished from tabulated atomic weight.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Main-group number is equated directly with valence-electron count despite the 1–18 group convention.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: The quick check incorrectly says Cl⁻ has more shells than Na and gives an unsupported mixed-radius order.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: The pre-2019 carbon-12 mole definition is presented as current.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Molar mass invokes the old mole definition; Ca(H₂PO₄)₂ rounding is inconsistent.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Fixed-volume examples can imply changing temperature changes the moles in a sealed sample.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: WHO nitrate guideline is overstated tenfold; ppm/ppb omit density and basis qualifications.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Endpoint is conflated with equivalence point; worked result prematurely rounds four-significant-figure data.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: NaOH concentration is missing from a salt-yield calculation; carbonate limited-acid example ignores bicarbonate formation.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Intermediate rounding is inconsistent with the worked final concentration; retain guard digits.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: CaSO₄ is universally labelled aqueous; bubbling is treated as a unique carbonate test.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Temperature is incorrectly said never to affect equilibrium yield.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Reactant count alone is used to classify synthesis, ignoring displacement and other multi-reactant reactions.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Reaction stoichiometry is used to guarantee a patient will not burp; limited-acid carbonate conditions are omitted.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Exact rate doubling is inferred without a rate law; final yield is declared unchanged without a limiting-reagent condition.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: The 1:1 neutralisation mole calculation is presented as a universal rule for polyprotic acids/bases.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Dissolution calorimetry swaps the sign of ΔT and omits the model behind using water mass rather than total solution.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Standard-state pressure is given as 1 atm instead of current 100 kPa convention.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: The ethyne hydrogenation Hess problem omits H₂ combustion enthalpy; the stated equations alone cannot yield the target.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Standard ΔG° is confused with actual-composition spontaneity, and crossover-temperature approximations are unstated.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: An unstated K value is used to guarantee NH₃ outnumbers every reactant, without composition or temperature conditions.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: The catalyst is called dead below a fixed temperature; a K value has no pressure/concentration convention stated.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Leaching is said never to stop; a single cycad procedure is generalised without public attribution.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Blood-buffer pKa is assigned to H₂CO₃ alone; acidaemia is conflated with acidosis; low ratio is assumed to mean raised CO₂.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Methyl orange 3.1–4.4 is said to bracket pH 5; exact EP bracketing is presented as the universal criterion.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Equivalence pH is incorrectly calculated by arithmetically averaging the jump’s pH bounds.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Antacid assay omits other acid-reactive ingredients and dissolved CO₂ interference assumptions.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: General formulas omit ring/multiple-unsaturation limits; branches and multiple bonds have incorrect equal naming priority.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: An ester is described as a C–O–O peroxide linkage; methanol classification exception is omitted.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: All C5+ alkanes are said to be liquids, ignoring higher solids and branched-isomer exceptions.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Alkanes are said to react only by substitution, contradicting combustion and cracking.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Industrial supported-phosphoric-acid ethene conditions are conflated with dilute sulfuric-acid laboratory hydration.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Two arbitrary bromine-water portions are used to identify an alkyne without controlling sample amounts.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: All alkyne hydration is said to give a ketone; ethyne gives ethanal under the described conditions.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Ethanol and ethane are called similar-mass controls; alcohol solubility has an absolute C5 cutoff and H-bonding is assumed identical.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Fermentation has a universal 35°C optimum and an absolute no-ethanol-with-oxygen rule; purified and raw product concentrations are compared.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Fuel-bond breaking is implied to release energy; experimental enthalpy bias is described as inevitable.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Butan-1-ol is treated as the only primary C4 alcohol; ketones are declared impossible to oxidise under any conditions.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: C4H8O is assumed to imply only carbonyl compounds and a positive Tollens result uniquely implies butanal.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Dimer bonds must break simultaneously, ionisation is fixed at 1%, and Mg acid reaction is said not to fizz.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Amides cannot ever accept a proton and carboxylic acids are the strongest organic acid class; diagnostic candidate restrictions are missing.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Reverse-polymer method adds extra H and violates carbon valency; PVC/recycling generalisations require correction.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Polyamides are assumed readily biodegradable, thermosets categorically unrecyclable, and finite-chain byproduct/end-group approximations are unstated.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Back-titration composition and CO₂ assumptions are missing; reported answers drop justified significant figures.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Precipitate colour alone is treated as unique identification without interference controls or restricted candidates.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: UV-visible spectroscopy is restricted to visibly coloured species; conventional AAS limits are generalised to all instruments.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Total coliforms are equated with a specific faecal-contamination indicator.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Unreferenced BOD bands are presented as universal pollution standards; the simple formula lacks assay assumptions.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Arsenic drinking-water guideline is ten times too high and arsenic biomagnification is incorrectly asserted.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Invented observations of blooms/fish deaths are inferred from a three-site concentration table; living algae respiration is omitted.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Chloramine residual is recommended as sufficient strong disinfection and a universal lower-DBP solution.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Carboxyl retention is treated as proof of analgesia and ester formation as proof of improved stomach safety.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Drug pKa interpretations omit acid/base identity and confuse solubility with guaranteed absorption.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Thalidomide good-R/bad-S model omits in-vivo interconversion; zero optical rotation is treated as proof of a racemate.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Rule-of-Five cut-offs wrongly exclude boundary values; codeine is called wholly inactive; patch suitability is assumed.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Atom-economy formula omits stoichiometric coefficients and E-factor alone is claimed to establish overall sustainability.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Charring before melting is treated as unique proof of a cross-linked thermoset.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Medicine-action/delivery metadata invents required 2017 syllabus statements; label enrichment and retain core spectroscopy coverage gap.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: A boiling plateau proves purity and CO₂ sublimation is called melting.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: ΔG versus ΔG° is conflated; finite favourability is called fundamentally irreversible and glucose entropy is inferred without adequate data.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Mass spectrometry is incorrectly described as direct elemental percentage-composition analysis.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.

findings.problem: Ion chromatography for nitrate/phosphate is falsely described as explicitly named in the 2017 syllabus.
findings.status: Implemented in scripts; structural checks pass; narration/rendered review pending.
